description: view_image through the RoomKit adapters of Python and Rust, on the same file: the exact text part, json.dumps(..., ensure_ascii=False) in Python's key order, the image part, and the words of a refusal and of a failure. The path carries characters JSON and the tool's text each escape. To regenerate, as a png or image bump changes the encoded preview and output_bytes: write this file's png at this file's path under a temporary root, then with Python's adapter, tool = ViewImage(await ViewImageTool.create(root)) and parts = await tool.handler('view_image', {'path': path}); text_part is parts[0].text and image_part is parts[1].url and parts[1].mime_type. Each refusal's message is the ToolRefusedError of its path, and failure's message the ToolFailedError under ViewImageTool.create(root, max_image_bytes=1). Dependabot bumps each lockfile on its own and CI never runs the Rust half, so a mismatch shows only at a local make roomkit-check: run it and tests/python/test_roomkit_image.py after regenerating.
